messages.text: Proposal: move the Team plan from $49 to $59 next month. Expansion revenue is strong, but onboarding time per Team account is higher than we modeled.
I support the increase. At $49, Team gross margin is below target once implementation support is included. The tradeoff is we may lose some very small teams.
I'm worried about surprising current Team customers. Assuming we grandfather existing Team customers for 4 months, CS can handle the messaging.
Final decision: move Team pricing to $59 for new customers starting 2026-09-01, grandfather existing Team customers for 4 months, and review churn after the first renewal cycle.
